h: Torah, Nevi'im and Kesuvim in the Verses of the Mussaf: Past, Present and Future

p: where in each one are mentioned
pesukim from Torah, Nevi'im and Kesuvim,
For the pesukim of the Torah,
of the revelation of Kingship, Remembrance and Shofar
For this is the root of the Torah:
to teach us His ways, may He be blessed.
And all the pesukim of the Nevi'im
speak of and allude to the future to come,
And the pesukim of the Kesuvim
to the Divine conduct of the present.
of the past, the present and the future.
With this the question of Tosafos is answered
(רֹאשׁ הַשָּׁנָה לב, א דִּבּוּר הַמַּתְחִיל מַתְחִיל)
why we say pesukim of Kesuvim
And it alludes to the Name
which means: He was, He is, and He will be.

paragraphs.text: Tosafos, Rosh Hashanah 32a (s.v. maschil baTorah) — And if you ask: everywhere it is implied that Nevi'im take precedence over Kesuvim, as it says (Megillah 31a), "written in the Torah, repeated in the Nevi'im, and tripled in the Kesuvim," yet here the verses of Kesuvim come first and then the Nevi'im! One may answer: because the verses of Tehillim, Mishlei and Iyov preceded the Nevi'im.
